desc: The NEW AGM Rattler-C V2 thermal clip-on boasts a industry-leading 12 micron, high-sensitivity sub-20mk thermal detectors. These physical attributes provide users with some of the best image quality AGM has produced to date with potential detection ranges up to 1800 yards. The Rattler-C V2 thermal clip-ons provide clear image under harsh environment conditions like darkness, fog, smoke, dust, rain, snow, wood, camouflage, etc.
